描述_EN: after wiping the surface clean, a cream slip was applied and the piece was fired, creating this ornate two toned pattern. the pattern filling the remaining surface of the pillow was achieved by creating depressions in the clay, and passing over them with a dark coloured slip (a thinned firing clay) which settled into the grooves. the intricate decoration on this ceramic pillow, made during the song dynasty (960-1279) in northern china, was made using a mixture of techniques. these sections form the roundels inlayed into the clay surface that forms the top of this pillow. the roundels on the top face of the pillow were formed using a technique called marbling in which the potter stacked strips of clay together into a cylinder and sliced through horizontally to form a cross section.
描述_ZN: 将表面擦拭干净后，涂上奶油色的滑液，然后烧制，形成了这种华丽的双色调图案。 填满枕头剩余表面的图案是通过在粘土中制造凹陷，并在其上涂抹深色的滑液（一种稀释的烧制粘土）来实现的，这种滑液沉淀在沟槽中。 这个陶瓷枕头上复杂的装饰，是在中国北方的宋代（960-1279）制作的，使用了混合技术。 这些部分形成了镶嵌在泥土表面的圆环，形成了这个枕头的顶部。 枕头顶面的圆环是用一种叫做大理石纹的技术形成的，在这种技术中，陶工将粘土条堆积在一起，形成一个圆柱体，然后横向切开，形成一个截面。
